candidate_reaudit.title: Use the authored native action name
candidate_reaudit.reason: 68694413; src/display.js uses action_name, model supplies fallback; preserve availability filters.

candidate_reaudit.title: Guard component recipe inputs
candidate_reaudit.reason: 68694413; src/crafting_recipes.js validates missing/unmatched native material/results before RNG; main rejects stale selections.

candidate_reaudit.title: Keep clamped trade requests immutable
candidate_reaudit.reason: 68694413; src/trade.js copies requests, preserving native grouped quote/settlement. No scalar-price rollback.

candidate_reaudit.title: Hint at known remaining clear rewards
candidate_reaudit.reason: src/fork_discovery_views.js extends the existing heard-note contract to explicit authored public hints. Infested field description publicly discloses its recognition thresholds. Both display refresh paths use the existing reader. Hidden rows contribute no marker.

candidate_reaudit.title: Reauthor the Fort resource and quest chain
candidate_reaudit.reason: Schoko Fort chain belongs exclusively to fork-fort. Existing Waypost Fort (f62e264e) is a separate original campaign; no duplicate Schoko implementation here.

candidate_reaudit.title: Filter crafting to currently makeable known recipes
candidate_reaudit.reason: 68694413 and d49cb911; Makeable now filter plus selected-row recovery and craft detail already exist. Never-made history cannot be inferred from present stock; omit that unsupported marker.

candidate_reaudit.title: Repair a demonstrated old-save entitlement idempotently
candidate_reaudit.reason: Current v06/save compatibility stages earned unlocks and preserves retired content. No demonstrated missing entitlement in these pins/current fixtures. Inventing historical rewards from max skill is incorrect even for a solo player. No speculative save repair.

candidate_reaudit.title: Knowledge-gated reverse source index
candidate_reaudit.reason: Native Item log now reverses only already disclosed bestiary loot edges for positively acquired items and killed enemies. Label is Known bestiary sources, not observed-drop provenance. Existing Fort journal retains actual/reported source records. Whole-registry undiscovered sources stay excluded.

candidate_reaudit.title: Opt-in return after defeat recovery
candidate_reaudit.reason: Native auto-return-to-bed and manual fast travel to last combat already work. Automatic waking/return is genuinely additional convenience, not forbidden abuse. It needs a saved cause/intent, current-world destination validation and cancellation across sleep/travel/restore; copying a Neko tick condition would affect voluntary sleep and stale realms. Retain manual return now; no fixed attempt cap.

candidate_reaudit.title: Expected value of already disclosed loot
candidate_reaudit.reason: Encountered enemy bestiary gains partial expected base loot value from positively acquired items only. Uses native drop modifier and count expectation, caps actual probability at 1, labels standard-quality/base-price/market/markup exclusions. No Neko gems or source/assets copied.

candidate_reaudit.title: Native gathering methods with actual count/time effects
candidate_reaudit.decision: Duplicate useful mechanism; omit broken neighbors
candidate_reaudit.reason: src/models/location.js getActivityEfficiency already scales real count, chance and duration from native gathering skills; main settles those exact outputs. Adding parallel generic Gather speed/efficiency tracks duplicates that progression. Efficient training is display-only in source, Failure expert lacks settlement consumer, and unclamped Lucky loot is not an independent rule worth transplanting.

candidate_reaudit.title: Repeatable funded local work board
candidate_reaudit.reason: f62e264e; native Waypost clerk accepts repeat actual deliveries from finite funds with custody/save staging. No fixed once cap on paid work. A second guild_jobs clock/ledger would duplicate it; further regional customers are new content, not a safe mechanical transplant.

candidate_reaudit.title: Resource-funded alternate combat mode
candidate_reaudit.decision: Duplicate paid stance pattern; mana variant deferred
candidate_reaudit.reason: src/combat_stances.js already supplies earned stamina-funded alternate functions; native combat owns fuel/counters. Fueled mana stance is live but its magic module is unused/invalid and no acquisition/casting/counter chain accompanies it. Mana-funded magic remains possible for a world with authored spells; do not turn every ordinary weapon hit into a global mana multiplier.

candidate_reaudit.title: Connected original gathering-material sinks
candidate_reaudit.decision: Newer native connected sinks already adopted; incomplete catalog deferred
candidate_reaudit.reason: Current Days 4–7 include monster bone processing/handles, Gryphon pinion/trophy and Frumious claw/blade. Suraimu remaining Spiritwood/Magisteel names have acquisition but missing downstream functions. Do not add dead stock or change all worlds to Tensura. A source-qualified original material chain needs its own actual source and sink, not the TS graph.

candidate_reaudit.title: Meter-driven traversal scene
candidate_reaudit.decision: Deferred new traversal scene, not rejected engine capability
candidate_reaudit.reason: Current native action/route commitments and Climbing support original traversal; Sardine grip/height/falling-rock interaction is additional content with no native interchangeable scene. No engine/toolchain port or rat image copy. Reauthor when selecting an actual reachable cliff with grip costs, retreat and failure aftermath; preserve all-world possibility.

candidate_reaudit.title: Discovered damage-type weakness
candidate_reaudit.decision: Deferred typed offense authoring; defensive preparation already adapted
candidate_reaudit.reason: Native optional absorb_e3 preparation already responds to encountered enemies/known bestiary with real defensive effects. Angular offensive weakness is a distinct useful future rule, but current ordinary weapons expose weapon family, not that games element enumeration. Requires world-specific attack types/known evidence/resistance/counters and native battle fixtures. Do not infer universal fire weakness from a tag or replace combat with broken OneMore code.

candidate_reaudit.title: Legacy alias migration principle
candidate_reaudit.decision: Already native principle; no new rename
candidate_reaudit.reason: Extra old candidate beyond requested FNA01–16 included for completeness. Current guild ID is intentionally retained and v06 migration preserves legacy data. Bippy item-only aliases omit quest/kill domains; no selected rename warrants adding them.
